user.title: Connect to FrameIT
user.description: Enter the URL and admin credentials for your FrameIT server.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the FrameIT server. Check the URL and that the server is running.

abort.already_configured: This FrameIT server is already configured.

init.title: Now Playing
init.description: Mirror a media player to any frame with its Now Playing switch turned on. The token authenticates Home Assistant to the FrameIT now-playing webhook; the server shows it only once, when it is generated.

data_description.now_playing_source: The player whose artwork and track details are sent to FrameIT. Leave blank to turn now-playing reporting off.
data_description.now_playing_token: Paste an existing token, or tick the box below to have FrameIT generate one.
data_description.generate_token: Mints a fresh token on the server and stores it here. This invalidates any token already in use.

error.token_failed: FrameIT could not generate a token. Check that the server is reachable and try again.
